title: The Chip War Comes To Southeast Asia
gist: Gavekal teaser: after accusing Moonshot AI of using Nvidia chips in Thai data centers, Washington is moving to close the loophole letting Chinese AI labs rent restricted chips in third countries. Southeast Asia is the main battleground, and a crackdown could cool its data-center investment boom while forcing Thailand, Malaysia and Indonesia to abandon hedging.

insights.claim: In July 2026 the White House accused Chinese startup Moonshot AI of training its models on Nvidia's most advanced chips hosted in Thai data centers, a legal workaround around US export controls on China.
insights.speaker: Gavekal Research
insights.so_what: Signals Washington is actively policing compute access by Chinese AI labs, not just physical chip shipments.
